blocks.html: Where a structure or portions of a structure are designated as fire access roads as defined in Chapter 5 of the New York City Fire Code, the structure shall be designed for the live loading specified in Section 1607.7.1 of this code or those identified in Chapter 5 of the New York City Fire Code, whichever produces the greater load effects.
